inlines.v: BUN'DLE, noun 1. A number of things put together. 2. A roll; any thing bound or rolled into a convenient form for conveyance; as a bundle of lace; a bundle of hay. BUNDLE, verb transitive To tie or bind in a bundle or roll; often followed by up; as, to bundle up clothes.
